biggest_catch: Cashback is a rebate on money you were already going to spend — it is not income and not guaranteed earnings. The card must be linked and the offer added BEFORE you swipe; purchases made before you add the offer earn nothing.
catches: Cashback is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings — offers, rates, and availability change.
The offer must be added to your card before the in-store purchase; retroactive credit is not possible.
Confirmation takes 3–14 weeks after the purchase is pending — this is not fast money.
Balance below $5.01 carries forward to the next quarterly payment; closing or terminating the account forfeits rewards.
Debit cards must be run as credit to qualify.
Offers are generally one purchase each and usually active for about 45 days.

s6.note: 6 concrete actions: create account, link card, add offer, pay in store, wait, receive payment.

steps: Link an eligible credit or debit card in your Rakuten wallet.
Browse in-store offers and add the ones you want BEFORE you shop — one offer activation covers one purchase.
Go to the store and pay in person with the linked card (run debit as credit).
Check your Rakuten account within a few days to confirm the purchase shows as pending.
Wait for confirmation — typically 3–14 weeks after purchase.
Once confirmed and your balance reaches $5.01, you are paid on the next quarterly date (Feb 15, May 15, Aug 15, or Nov 15) via Big Fat Check or PayPal.
